summary: This page covers 5.1 (The z-Transform 497). OCR text begins with: 5.1 The z-Transform 497 We can determine a1 and a2 by clearing fractions. Or we may use a shortcut. For example, to determine a2 , we multiply both sides of Eq. (5.10) by z and let z → ∞. This yields 0 = −3 − 0 + 0 + a2 ⇒ a2 = 3 This result leaves only one unknown, a1 , which is readily determined by letting z take any convenient value, say, z = 0, on both sides of Eq. (5.10). This produces 12 1 a1 3
